fusions.name: Gnawing Grip
fusions.desc: A quick bite that deals 8 damage and has a 40% chance to leave the target [Diseased] for 6 seconds. It costs 6% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Swarm Over
fusions.desc: Everything within 3.5 tiles takes 28 damage. For 12 seconds after it hits, allies strike 20% harder.

fusions.name: Scurrying Pack
fusions.desc: Calls a pack that fights for 16 seconds, striking an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Last Off the Ship
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 30%, you regain 3 health a second for 6 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.
